text:
deploy-bot: Staged rollout initiated by @ashley: text-gen v2.4.2 -> 8% (eu-west:5%, us-east:3%). Change window 20m. Watch errors for 10m. ID: canary-6161717171
ashley: Monitoring now. Thresholds: 5xx >1% or latency p99+100ms -> pause.
mike: spotting a small spike in eu-west tokenizer errors: 0.1% -> 0.8% over 4m, looks tied to a partner slice.
sara: quick trace shows `normalizer.normalize()` raising InvalidUnicode on inputs with embedded nulls. Only on v2.4.2.
eng-release-lead: Vote: keep rolling, pin eu-west, or full pause?
ashley: recommend pin eu-west to v2.4.1 and continue us-east. Limits blast radius and buys QA time.
mike: +1 pin. Capture heap + logs before draining.
sara: +1 pin. adding failing payloads to RT-4020. I have a tentative guard in a branch.
deploy-bot: Executing route-pin --region eu-west-1 --to v2.4.1 --reason "normalizer edge case"
deploy-bot: Route pin applied. eu-west traffic restored to v2.4.1. Rollout continues in us-east (3%).
ashley: Noted in release notes and paused eu-west progression. QA to run quick regression; if green we'll cut v2.4.3 and resume.
eng-release-lead: Thanks. Keep updates to RT-4020 and post status in 20m.
